name: Sandsorrow Watch
summary: At Sandsorrow Watch, Sandfury trolls hold the desert ruins and dunes just west of Gadgetzan.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Leave Gadgetzan through its western gate and you enter Sandfury territory almost at once. Trolls and shambling dead command the open desert, while an old watch tower rises at the eastern edge.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost
sections.body: Sandfury trolls hold even the eastern tower, within sight of Gadgetzan's walls. From its heights, they watch the goblin town. Travelers leaving through the western gate step onto a tense frontier, where settlers and sand trolls face one another.

aliases: how to get to sandsorrow watch
faq.answer: Sandsorrow Watch lies directly west of Gadgetzan, in Tanaris's northern desert plains. You reach it almost at once through the town's western gate.
Hostile Sandfury trolls and their undead minions occupy the ruins, dunes, and eastern watch tower.

faq.q: Why are there undead trolls at Sandsorrow Watch?
faq.answer: The Sandfury practice necromantic arts and voodoo. They raise fallen warriors as Sandfury Zombies to guard their territory and outposts across Tanaris.

faq.q: What threats can adventurers expect in the surrounding dunes?
faq.answer: Sandfury Axe Throwers, Firecallers, and Hideskinners patrol the dunes with reanimated troll zombies. Leave the main path west of Gadgetzan and roving Sandfury warbands may overwhelm you.

angles.text: No smith works at the Sandfury-held watch tower. Desert smiths gather behind Gadgetzan's walls, just to the east.
As a troll, you will find no kinship with the Sandfury. They see outsiders as invaders to crush and raise as shambling corpses.
